title: LazySpan.__getattr__ must fall back to Span.__getattr__ on a miss
answers: lazy loaded span gives bare AttributeError for span.get
LazySpan missing attribute hint not shown
why does LazySpan not show the span get hint
body:
Symptom: A span loaded lazily (LazySpan) reports a bare AttributeError for span.get, without the attribute-access hint that eager spans show.
Root cause: mlflow/entities/span.py:LazySpan.__getattr__ called object.__getattribute__(self, name) directly, so a missing name raised the generic error and never reached the base hook.
Fix pattern: Keep self._ensure_materialized() first, then wrap object.__getattribute__ in try/except AttributeError and return super().__getattr__(name) on a miss. This lets the base class decide the message.
Constraints: Any __getattr__ override in the span hierarchy must delegate to super().__getattr__ on a miss, or the base hint silently disappears for that subclass. Materialization must still run before the lookup.
Tests: tests/entities/test_span.py:test_span_get_raises_helpful_attribute_error covers LazySpan(span.to_dict()).
applies: LazySpan and other subclasses that override __getattr__ in mlflow/entities/span.py.
says: Lazy loaded trace spans do not show helpful error hints when accessing missing attributes.
Missing attribute error message on trace spans lacks suggestions shown on standard spans.
Trace spans fetched on demand should provide helpful suggestions when invalid attributes are accessed.
Accessing properties on lazily loaded spans throws a generic error without user hints.
search: In mlflow/entities/span.py, LazySpan.__getattr__ must catch AttributeError from object.__getattribute__ and delegate to super().__getattr__ so base class attribute hints are preserved. self._ensure_materialized() must run before the attribute lookup, and all __getattr__ overrides across the span hierarchy must delegate misses to super().__getattr__. The behavior is tested by tests/entities/test_span.py:test_span_get_raises_helpful_attribute_error.
